description: Agent Recovery: submit a task system’s state reporting: whether it has a state for partly done work apart from done and failed, whether a partly done task lists the pieces that did not complete, what lets a task be reported done (every part confirmed, the last step returning, no error raised or any response) and what it reports when a task fails partway (partly done, failed, done, still in progress or nothing), plus optionally the tasks it reported on after a mid-task failure with each piece, whether it finished and the pieces the report named as missing. The signed report says whether partial completion is visible and labeled as partial with its missing pieces named, and names a system that reports done on a mid-task failure, on any response or on no error, or reports nothing, and every task reported done with unfinished pieces (half-done work presenting as finished), then no partial state, done on the last step alone, a partial failure shown as failed or still running, missing pieces left unnamed and every task reported failed with finished pieces, with the fix for each. This reads what an interrupted task’s reported state shows across a system: one paid call’s delivered result against its order is wever_result-validation-check, what a stop does to in-flight actions is wever_kill-switch-check and where an interrupted task picks up is wever_resume-point-check. Verdict half_done_looks_done, partial_state_gaps, partial_state_unverified or partial_shown_as_partial. POST /api/partial-state-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-recovery-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-recovery/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

done_when.description: What lets the system report a task as done: every part confirmed, the last step returning, no error raised, or any response.

names_missing.description: A partly done task lists the pieces that did not complete.

on_mid_task_failure.description: What the system reports when a task fails partway: partly done, failed, done, still in progress, or nothing.

partial_state.description: The system has a state for partly done work, apart from done and failed.

system.description: The task system, such as the booking pipeline.

tasks.description: Tasks the system reported on after a mid-task failure, with their pieces.

missing_named.description: The pieces the report named as missing.

parts.description: The pieces of the task, each with whether it finished.

name.description: A piece of the task, such as hotel booked.

reported.description: The state the system reported for the task.

name: wever_partial-state-check
title: Partial state check
